text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels rewarding, but a realized profit alone doesn’t show whether selling was the best decision; consider each stock’s prospects too.","A few winning sales haven’t prevented my overall account value from fluctuating, so I should judge progress across the whole portfolio, not just individual trades.","I rarely trade, and holding through month-to-month ups and downs can be reasonable; I should avoid making decisions based only on short-term price changes."]}
